title: Drive to Puno

weather.note: Higher & colder; sunny dry days, nights near/below freezing. Dry air makes the sun feel fierce and the cold bite hard.

glance: Long, scenic drive (~7.5 hrs) across the high Altiplano to Puno on Lake Titicaca. The landscape — endless plains, alpaca herds — is the attraction.

notes: The longest drive of the trip

picks.name: Jirón Lima
picks.note: The pedestrian spine; alpaca-wool shops, cafés, trout restaurants; best stroll in town.

picks.name: Kuntur Wasi / Condor Hill
picks.note: Steep climb to a giant condor statue and the best view over the lake; sunset if you have energy.

notes: Intrepid flags occasional political unrest around Puno — the leader will adjust transport if needed.
